# ColorOS Control Center for HyperOS **ColorOS-style quick settings for HyperOS, with square tiles you can move and resize freely.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - ColorOS-style control center with square, resizable tiles and a free drag-and-drop layout - Sound tile with a sliding control, plus a tile that shows battery health of connected earbuds - Caffeine tile - Adjustable blur radius - iOS-style volume panel - Settings for the dynamic music island - Optional top bar with edit, settings and power-menu buttons next to the clock ## Requirements - HyperOS 3 or HyperOS 4 - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Android 15+: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module. ## Screenshots

ColorOS Control Center for HyperOS

ColorOS-style quick settings for HyperOS, with square tiles you can move and resize freely.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • ColorOS-style control center with square, resizable tiles and a free drag-and-drop layout
  • Sound tile with a sliding control, plus a tile that shows battery health of connected earbuds
  • Caffeine tile
  • Adjustable blur radius
  • iOS-style volume panel
  • Settings for the dynamic music island
  • Optional top bar with edit, settings and power-menu buttons next to the clock

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS 3 or HyperOS 4
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/ColorOS_Control_Center/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Android 15+: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module.
